career_ladder.note: Officers recruited through the Odisha Civil Services Examination for executive administrative cadres begin as Odisha Administrative Service (OAS) Group A (Junior Branch) officers and advance through the state administrative hierarchy before induction into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) under the state promotion quota pursuant to the IAS (Appointment by Promotion) Regulations.

exam_scheme.note: Governed by the Odisha Civil Services (Combined Competitive Recruitment Examination) Rules, 2022 (notified by GA&PG Department vide Notification No. 24040/Gen dated 05.09.2022, published in Odisha Gazette Extraordinary No. 2378). The scheme aligns with UPSC CSE comprising Preliminary Examination (400 marks screening), Main Examination (1,750 merit marks across 7 conventional descriptive papers plus 2 qualifying language papers of 250 marks each), and Personality Test (250 marks), yielding a total of 2,000 marks for final ranking.

financial_package.note: Officers recruited to Group A Junior Branch executive cadres (Odisha Administrative Service, Odisha Police Service, and Odisha Finance Service) receive compensation governed by the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay Rules, 2017 (ORSP Rules 2017) at Pay Matrix Level 12 (Scale ₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500 with entry basic pay of ₹56,100). Allied Group B cadres (ORS, OLS, OCS, OTS) enter at Pay Matrix Level 10 (Scale ₹44,900 - ₹1,42,400).
financial_package.pay_source_label: Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017, Finance Department, Government of Odisha
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary computed from Level 12 entry basic ₹56,100 + 58% DA (₹32,538) + Odisha HRA (8%–16% depending on posting in Bhubaneswar/Cuttack municipal corporation area vs district/sub-divisional headquarters) + medical and special executive allowances. In-hand estimate reflects statutory deductions including 10% NPS (Basic + DA = ₹8,864), Professional Tax (₹200), and Group Insurance Scheme (GIS).
official_perks: Designated official executive accommodation / government quarters in posting district or sub-division
Government official vehicle with driver and fuel entitlement for executive field postings (BDO, Tahsildar, Sub-Collector, DSP)
Comprehensive medical treatment reimbursement under Odisha Government Servants' Medical Attendance Rules for officer and dependent family
Dearness Allowance (DA) and House Rent Allowance (HRA) indexed to state government revisions
Dedicated administrative office setup with supporting ministerial and revenue/police staff
Contributory pension coverage under New Pension Scheme (NPS) with 14% state government contribution
